public_rationale: The deadline is still ahead, and no decisive early event was found. The forecast specifically concerns what happens without continued large-business revenue growth. That antecedent remains unknown over the forecast period, so the conditional-scoring rule prevents adjudication. Present growth or alternative revenue channels cannot settle the necessity claim.
limitations: The revenue threshold and meaning of sustained large-business growth require interpretation.
Failure to reach the target while enterprise revenue grows would not establish the conditional forecast.

conditions: unless revenue from paying big business customers keeps going up

statement.excerpt: Needless to say, OpenAI can’t make its ambitious revenue numbers — 13x-ing current revenue in five years — unless revenue from paying big business customers keeps going up and up and up and up and up.

from_speaker: can’t make its ambitious revenue numbers
unless revenue from paying big business customers keeps going up
our_interpretation: Read the statement as a necessary-condition forecast: if large-business revenue does not keep growing, OpenAI will not reach the stated total-revenue target.
The conditional antecedent is failure of sustained large-business revenue growth, not the occurrence of growth.
Use approximately $200 billion in realized annual revenue during calendar 2030 as the target supplied by the surrounding passage.
Use December 31, 2030 as the latest deadline permitted by the named year.
Interpret repeated 'going up' as sustained growth across the forecast period, rather than growth every day or month.
The financial target is a press-reported estimate, not a specified GAAP measure.
criteria.support_condition: If the absence of sustained large-business revenue growth is established, OpenAI falls short of approximately $200 billion in realized annual revenue in 2030.
criteria.contradiction_condition: OpenAI achieves approximately $200 billion in realized annual revenue by the deadline despite an established absence of sustained large-business revenue growth.
